title: The Log Swing
lines: Jane and Pete want a swing at home.
Dad slings a rope up on a big pine.
Pete gets a fine log to sit on.
But the log slips off the rope!
Jane cuts a hole in it with Dad.
The rope goes in the hole, and it holds.
Pete gets on. Jane pulls him back.
"The best swing!" said Pete with a smile.

questions.ask: What did Pete get to sit on?
questions.listenFor: A fine log. Line three says it. If your child is stuck, let them reread that line.

questions.ask: Why did Jane cut a hole in the log?
questions.listenFor: Because the log kept slipping off the rope, and the rope could go through the hole. Lines four to six carry it.

questions.ask: What would you make a swing seat out of? Tell me why that.
questions.listenFor: Any answer counts. You are listening for a reason that shows they understood why the log kept slipping.
